def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            cells = []
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            objects.append({"color": color, "cells": cells,
                            "box": (r0, c0, r1, c1),
                            "size": (r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1)})
    for obj in objects:
        r0, c0, r1, c1 = obj["box"]
        cellset = set(obj["cells"])
        slots = []
        visited = set()
        rectangular = True
        for r in range(r0, r1+1):
            for c in range(c0, c1+1):
                if (r, c) in cellset or (r, c) in visited:
                    continue
                comp = []
                stack = [(r, c)]
                visited.add((r, c))
                while stack:
                    y, x = stack.pop()
                    comp.append((y, x))
                    for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                        if r0 <= ny <= r1 and c0 <= nx <= c1 and (ny,nx) not in cellset and (ny,nx) not in visited:
                            visited.add((ny,nx))
                            stack.append((ny,nx))
                ys = [y for y,x in comp]
                xs = [x for y,x in comp]
                sh = max(ys)-min(ys)+1
                sw = max(xs)-min(xs)+1
                if len(comp) != sh*sw:
                    rectangular = False
                    break
                slots.append((comp, (sh,sw)))
            if not rectangular:
                break
        obj["slots"] = slots if rectangular and slots else None
    for base in objects:
        if not base["slots"]:
            continue
        needed = [size for comp,size in base["slots"]]
        pieces = [o for o in objects if o is not base and len(o["cells"]) == o["size"][0]*o["size"][1]]
        if len(pieces) != len(needed):
            continue
        if sorted(o["size"] for o in pieces) != sorted(needed):
            continue
        r0,c0,r1,c1 = base["box"]
        out = [[base["color"]]*(c1-c0+1) for _ in range(r1-r0+1)]
        remaining = pieces[:]
        for comp,size in base["slots"]:
            piece = next(o for o in remaining if o["size"] == size)
            remaining.remove(piece)
            for y,x in comp:
                out[y-r0][x-c0] = piece["color"]
        return out
    return grid
